reason_for_v2.failure_mode: a source may begin reliable change tracking at year T while retaining pre-T join dates for surviving constituents, so that constituents deleted before T are absent entirely
reason_for_v2.why_v1_could_not_see_it: V1's fixtures span 2014-2025; a survivor-only history passes all of them

lineage.mechanism: the inherited block is LOADED from the sealed V1 artifact rather than retyped, so equality is structural

selection_rule_fixed_in_advance.explicitly_not: candidate behaviour — this rule was fixed before any source was searched, so a second fixture cannot be added later because the first proved inconvenient
selection_rule_fixed_in_advance.outcome: two found with equal boundary certainty; both included

insufficient_coverage_rule.statement: absence of the deleted security or event is NOT evidence that it was never a constituent
insufficient_coverage_rule.rule: if a candidate's historical coverage begins after a fixture's effective deletion date, the classification is INSUFFICIENT_HISTORICAL_COVERAGE
insufficient_coverage_rule.explicitly_not_PASS: silence must never be scored as agreement
insufficient_coverage_rule.explicitly_not_NOT_A_MEMBER: silence must never be scored as a factual negative
insufficient_coverage_rule.why: this is the same FALSE vs UNAVAILABLE distinction the minute-availability amendment draws for market data. A universe history needs it for the same reason: 'we have no record' and 'it was not a member' are different statements, and conflating them manufactures a clean-looking universe.

boundary_convention.our_rule: effective prior to the open of session E means E-1 is the last session of old membership and E is the first session of new membership
boundary_convention.v2_addition: F8 and F9 are phrased 'after the close of trading on D', which means D is the last session of old membership and the next session is the first without it
boundary_convention.equivalence: both phrasings describe the same boundary from opposite sides; a source must map them identically
boundary_convention.calendar_independence: both V2 fixtures were checked to fall on a Friday whose following Monday is a trading day, so neither depends on the unresolved P9 exchange calendar

residual_limitation.issue: both pre-2012 fixtures are M&A-driven deletions
residual_limitation.consequence: a pre-2012 MARKET-CAP-driven deletion is not separately covered, so a source that records pre-2012 acquisitions but not pre-2012 rebalance removals would still pass
residual_limitation.status: RECORDED, NOT PATCHED — the selection rule caps this set at two, and that cap was fixed before searching. Recording the residue is preferable to quietly exceeding the rule that makes the set credible.
residual_limitation.note: the defect class V2 targets — no pre-T deletions at all — is covered
